facts.fact: 她的夜市执念：想找「虫串」骗王储吃
facts.anchor: worms on a stick. It sounded disgusting, she knew, but it was actually quite delicious.

facts.fact: 反恐课：市场是暗杀者最想不到的地方（他从未逛过市集）；她补刀盔甲太扎眼
facts.anchor: That armour does kind of make you stand out, though.

facts.fact: 「比我强的人你遇过——就是我」的对答：他邀战、她应战（练好 jump 再说）
facts.anchor: “You did the day you met me.”

facts.fact: 砍价戏：10→5→9→7+肉饼成交——市场语言学完胜
facts.anchor: Seven, and you throw in that meat pie behind you for free.

facts.fact: Branko/Prinx 认出王子跪地痛哭求饶——他的「reputation」第一次被市井实演
她索「精神损失费」：7 银+1 金赔商贩惊吓；顺走 spare clothing 给他换装
facts.anchor: dropping one gold coin among the rest.

facts.fact: 尾段：王子穿便装抓领口如坐针毡——喜剧收尾
facts.anchor: His entire body locked up once more, and she couldn’t help but laugh.
